shortDescription: Manage IPSec Tunnels on the firewall with subset of settings.

options.name: ak_ike_gateway
options.description: Name of the existing IKE gateway (auto-key).

options.name: ak_ipsec_crypto_profile
options.description: Name of the existing IPsec profile or use default (auto-key).

options.name: anti_replay
options.description: Enable anti-replay check on this tunnel.

options.name: api_key
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The API key to use instead of generating it using I(username) / I(password).

options.name: commit
options.description: B(Deprecated) Please use M(paloaltonetworks.panos.panos_commit_firewall), M(paloaltonetworks.panos.panos_commit_panorama), M(paloaltonetworks.panos.panos_commit_push) instead. HORIZONTALLINE Commit changes after creating object.  If I(ip_address) is a Panorama device, and I(device_group) or I(template) are also set, perform a commit to Panorama and a commit-all to the device group/template.

options.name: copy_flow_label
options.description: Copy IPv6 flow label for 6in6 tunnel from inner packet to IPSec packet (not recommended) (7.0+).

options.name: copy_tos
options.description: Copy IP TOS bits from inner packet to IPSec packet (not recommended).

options.name: disabled
options.description: Disable the IPsec tunnel.

options.name: enable_tunnel_monitor
options.description: Enable tunnel monitoring on this tunnel.

options.name: gathered_filter
options.description: When I(state=gathered). An advanced filtering option to filter results returned from PAN-OS. Refer to the guide discussing I(gathered_filter) for more information.

options.name: gps_certificate_profile
options.description: Profile for authenticating GlobalProtect gateway certificates (global-protect-satellite).

options.name: gps_interface
options.description: Interface to communicate with portal (global-protect-satellite).

options.name: gps_interface_ipv4_floating_ip
options.description: Floating IPv4 IP address in HA Active-Active configuration (7.0+) (global-protect-satellite).

options.name: gps_interface_ipv4_ip
options.description: Exact IPv4 IP address if interface has multiple IP addresses (global-protect-satellite).

options.name: gps_interface_ipv6_floating_ip
options.description: Floating IPv6 IP address in HA Active-Active configuration (8.0+) (global-protect-satellite).

options.name: gps_interface_ipv6_ip
options.description: Exact IPv6 IP address if interface has multiple IP addresses (8.0+) (global-protect-satellite).

options.name: gps_local_certificate
options.description: GlobalProtect satellite certificate file name (global-protect-satellite).

options.name: gps_portal_address
options.description: GlobalProtect portal address (global-protect-satellite).

options.name: gps_prefer_ipv6
options.description: Prefer to register portal in IPv6 (8.0+) (global-protect-satellite).

options.name: gps_publish_connected_routes
options.description: Enable publishing of connected and static routes (global-protect-satellite).

options.name: gps_publish_routes
options.description: Specify list of routes to publish to GlobalProtect gateway (global-protect-satellite).

options.name: ip_address
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The IP address or hostname of the PAN-OS device being configured.

options.name: ipv6
options.description: Use IPv6 for the IPsec tunnel (7.0+)

options.name: mk_auth_key
options.description: Authentication key (manual-key).

options.name: mk_auth_type
options.description: Authentication type for tunnel access (manual-key).

options.name: mk_esp_encryption
options.description: Encryption algorithm for tunnel traffic (manual-key).

options.name: mk_esp_encryption_key
options.description: Encryption key (manual-key).

options.name: mk_interface
options.description: Interface to terminate tunnel (manual-key).

options.name: mk_local_address_floating_ip
options.description: Floating IP address in HA Active-Active configuration (manual-key).

options.name: mk_local_address_ip
options.description: Exact IP address if interface has multiple IP addresses (manual-key).

options.name: mk_local_spi
options.description: Outbound SPI in hex (manual-key).

options.name: mk_protocol
options.description: Protocol for traffic through the tunnel (manual-key).

options.name: mk_remote_address
options.description: Tunnel peer IP address (manual-key).

options.name: mk_remote_spi
options.description: Inbound SPI in hex (manual-key).

options.name: name
options.description: Name for the IPSec tunnel.

options.name: password
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The password to use for authentication.  This is ignored if I(api_key) is specified.

options.name: port
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The port number to connect to the PAN-OS device on.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: state
options.description: The state.

options.name: template
options.description: (Panorama only) The template this operation should target. Mutually exclusive with I(template_stack).

options.name: template_stack
options.description: (Panorama only) The template stack this operation should target. Mutually exclusive with I(template).

options.name: tunnel_interface
options.description: Specify existing tunnel interface that will be used.

options.name: tunnel_monitor_dest_ip
options.description: Destination IP to send ICMP probe.

options.name: tunnel_monitor_profile
options.description: Monitoring action.

options.name: tunnel_monitor_proxy_id
options.description: Which proxy-id (or proxy-id-v6) the monitoring traffic will use.

options.name: type
options.description: Type of IPsec tunnel.

options.name: username
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The username to use for authentication.  This is ignored if I(api_key) is specified.
